inj.note: After tweaking his hamstring late in the Giants' Week 7 overtime win over Houston, Skattebo was seen working off to the side Monday during an unofficial practice coming out of a bye week. Skattebo will still have three more opportunities to log on-field reps in Week 9, and the Giants should have a better idea about his status for Sunday's game based on what he's able to do in those sessions. Devin Singletary would be the next man up in the New York backfield if Skattebo is unable to play or is limited against the Eagles.

news.h: Giants' Cam Skattebo, John Harbaugh object to lowering helmet penalty
news.d: Giants coach John Harbaugh and Cam Skattebo took issue with a first-quarter penalty call Sunday against Houston, when the running back was flagged for unnecessary roughness for impermissible helmet contact.

news.h: Cam Skattebo & Co. answer John Harbaugh's call, lead Giants to OT win
news.d: The Giants' running back group was called out this past week by coach John Harbaugh. They all stepped up Sunday in Houston.

news.h: Singletary's 30-yard run in OT gives Giants 27-21 win over Texans
news.d: — Two weeks ago, Cam Skattebo's fumble in overtime cost the New York Giants a chance at a win.

news.h: Sources: Cam Skattebo expected to resume role as Giants' lead RB vs. Texans
news.d: Cam Skattebo is expected to return to his role as the Giants' lead running back against the Texans.

news.h: Cam Skattebo set to return to Giants RB mix after being 'taught a lesson'
news.d: After zero carries in Week 6, Cam Skattebo says he took a step back to evaluate and correct, and Giants' coach says he should return to the running back mix vs. the Texans.
